scope: Numerical diagnosis only: SES selection erratum + multi-candidate complementarity, and frozen W3 response transfer to SFEC v1 Valid replacements. No training, no fine-tuning, no hyper-parameter search.

erratum.description: The parent analysis used per_split['random_expected_mse'] as the SELECT-uniform-expected baseline in the frozen-selection intervention. The corrected baseline is the SELECT arm's own per-candidate mean squared/absolute error. The corrected RMSE must equal the SELECT manifest rmse_expected.
erratum.unaffected: The main-table SELECT-minus-RANDOM comparison already used RANDOM's expected MSE on both sides and is unaffected. The route label was based on that comparison, so it is unaffected.
